gigapan.description: Another flea with flash tube as transmission lighting source. Taken with 20x objective this micro gigapan is composed of 11 wide x 13 high x 37 stacks of images. There is some lighting issues in this gigapan beacuse the flash is doing some additional metering. There is also a stitching error on the left side. The capture stopped prematurely and I had to align the last column by hand, which obviously didn't turn out too well.
